sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Debrief completed; suiting up for deployment and patrols.
Commencing Alpha Route, remaining mainly on the main strip due to calls received here during busy trading hours.
Standing under shelter at Footlocker due to heavy rainfall.

Response call from the Cotton On manager regarding a group who stole items five minutes earlier, last seen heading down towards Britomart; unclear due to the construction blockage at the lights whether they crossed towards Victoria Street East or West or continued down towards Britomart. Described as three females and one male, all in black, the male wearing a black durag. Stolen items include a baby blue tracksuit, jeans and most likely other items.

Swept all the way to Britomart with no sign of the individuals; standing by to show presence and keep a lookout for them. Advised the store to call us straight away in future — staff did not notice the theft until it was too late.
Thoroughly scanning the area for the individuals.
Walked down to the corner of Fort Street and Fort Lane in case they came through the back way — Victoria Street East down Lorne Street and High Street towards Britomart.
Spoke with security at Walker & Hall regarding any information on the individuals; they had not seen a group matching the description.
Standing by under shelter due to heavy rain and wind.
Check-in at Commercial Bay, all clear.
Welfare checks along Queen Street up to Aotea Square.

sections.title: Night Shift (22:30 – 06:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Night Shift deployed; short debrief before patrolling.
Debrief completed; standing by at HQ charging the Ops Phone before commencing full patrols (22:50–23:36).
Half of Queen Street all clear, no issues; patrolling down Shortland Street.
Shortland Street all clear, no issues; continuing down Fort Street.
Welfare check at KFC, Jo & Joes and Wilson Carpark, all clear.
Full sweep of Fort Street; welfare check at Tribe Hotel and The Mermaid, all clear. Arrived at Harbour Suites, maintaining presence.
Response call from 77 Convenience Store regarding a young male individual sitting outside the front entrance, disturbing customers and lying on the floor; en route to the location.

Arrived at the response location; the individual was still in front of the entrance, sitting down. Approached and asked him nicely to move to the side; noticed the individual was unwell, so standing by to assist.
Contacted emergency services due to the severity of the situation; standing by until they arrive.
Standing by with the individual awaiting emergency services (00:32–01:15).
Emergency services arrived; standing by to provide any assistance.
